upstream.name: rclone/rclone
upstream.architecture: Go storage provider abstraction with backend remotes, copy/sync/check commands, fs provider contracts, filter rules, hash utilities, checksums, and fstest integration suites.

benchmarkDenominator.source: Shallow blob-filtered upstream clone at .upstream-cache/rclone; counted with git ls-tree -r --name-only HEAD and targeted reads of Makefile, COPYING, fs/filter, and fs/hash tests.

runnerStatus.reason: The full upstream runner was not executed in this modest lane run. rclone's Makefile quick target runs RCLONE_CONFIG="/notfound" go test ./..., while the full test target builds rclone and fstest/test_all before running provider integration remotes. That would require building/downloading the Go module graph and may exercise remote/backend integration fixtures, so this lane records a cloned static inventory rather than upstream pass parity.

probes.result: counted 327 Go test files and 836 testdata paths without running the upstream Go suite

mappedSemantics: fs/filter GlobPathToRegexp path semantics for leading slash anchoring, *, **, ?, brace alternation, and invalid glob errors.
Sync planning skips objects excluded by filter rules.
Checksum/size change detection remains native PHP without shelling out.
WordPress backup fixture filters uploads, WXR exports, and SQL dumps while excluding cache/log/source files.
benchmarkDenominator.warning: This replaces the seed denominator with a cloned static inventory, not upstream runner parity. Native PHP progress maps 7 focused lane tests against a 327-Go-test-file upstream denominator.

nativeImplementation.currentSlice: Native in-memory provider contract with object metadata, copy, list, checksum sync planning, and rclone-style path filter rules.

wordpressScenario: Portable WordPress backup/import/export sync for shared hosts and cloud storage providers, including filtered uploads, WXR exports, SQL dumps, and excluded cache/log/source artifacts.
nextTask: Map filesystem provider contract tests, hash set behavior, and rclone check/copy semantics.
